Here are the two POWL models implemented in Python using the `pm4py` library, exactly following the syntax and operator definitions provided in your instructions.

### 1. POWL Model with Potential Unfairness
This model introduces an `XOR` branch after the skill assessment. One path follows a standard merit-based evaluation (`CulturalFitCheck`), while the other follows a `CommunityAffiliationCheck` path that implicitly advantages candidates with specific local or club affiliations.

```python
import pm4py
from pm4py.objects.powl.obj import StrictPartialOrder, OperatorPOWL, Transition, SilentTransition
from pm4py.objects.process_tree.obj import Operator

# --- Activity Definitions ---
ReceiveApplication = Transition(label="ReceiveApplication")
DataCompletenessCheck = Transition(label="DataCompletenessCheck")
RequestMoreInfo = Transition(label="RequestMoreInfo")
SkillAssessment = Transition(label="SkillAssessment")
CulturalFitCheck = Transition(label="CulturalFitCheck")
CommunityAffiliationCheck = Transition(label="CommunityAffiliationCheck")
ManagerialReview = Transition(label="ManagerialReview")
FinalDecision = Transition(label="FinalDecision")
End = SilentTransition()

# --- Loop Structure: Data Completeness ---
# Executes DataCompletenessCheck, then either exits or does RequestMoreInfo before looping back
DataCompletenessLoop = OperatorPOWL(operator=Operator.LOOP, children=[DataCompletenessCheck, RequestMoreInfo])

# --- XOR Branch: Introduces Potential Bias ---
# Applicant is routed to EITHER standard evaluation OR community-affiliation-based evaluation
BiasXORBranch = OperatorPOWL(operator=Operator.XOR, children=[CulturalFitCheck, CommunityAffiliationCheck])

# --- Build Unfair POWL Model ---
nodes_unfair = [ReceiveApplication, DataCompletenessLoop, SkillAssessment, BiasXORBranch, ManagerialReview, FinalDecision, End]
powl_model_unfair = StrictPartialOrder(nodes=nodes_unfair)

# Define sequential execution order
powl_model_unfair.order.add_edge(ReceiveApplication, DataCompletenessLoop)
powl_model_unfair.order.add_edge(DataCompletenessLoop, SkillAssessment)
powl_model_unfair.order.add_edge(SkillAssessment, BiasXORBranch)
powl_model_unfair.order.add_edge(BiasXORBranch, ManagerialReview)
powl_model_unfair.order.add_edge(ManagerialReview, FinalDecision)
powl_model_unfair.order.add_edge(FinalDecision, End)
```

### 2. POWL Model Without Unfairness
This model removes the selective `XOR` branching. Every applicant undergoes the same standardized `CulturalFitCheck` regardless of background or affiliations, eliminating the structural source of bias while preserving the loop and sequential workflow.

```python
# --- Reuse Activity Definitions (same as above) ---

# --- Build Fair POWL Model ---
# All candidates follow a single, standardized path after skill assessment
nodes_fair = [ReceiveApplication, DataCompletenessLoop, SkillAssessment, CulturalFitCheck, ManagerialReview, FinalDecision, End]
powl_model_fair = StrictPartialOrder(nodes=nodes_fair)

# Define sequential execution order (no XOR branching)
powl_model_fair.order.add_edge(ReceiveApplication, DataCompletenessLoop)
powl_model_fair.order.add_edge(DataCompletenessLoop, SkillAssessment)
powl_model_fair.order.add_edge(SkillAssessment, CulturalFitCheck)
powl_model_fair.order.add_edge(CulturalFitCheck, ManagerialReview)
powl_model_fair.order.add_edge(ManagerialReview, FinalDecision)
powl_model_fair.order.add_edge(FinalDecision, End)
```

### Key Structural Differences & Bias Mechanism
| Feature | Model 1 (Unfair) | Model 2 (Fair) |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Post-Skill Path** | `XOR(CulturalFitCheck, CommunityAffiliationCheck)` | `CulturalFitCheck` (deterministic) |
| **Control Flow** | Exclusive choice creates two evaluative tracks | Linear, uniform track for all applicants |
| **Bias Source** | `CommunityAffiliationCheck` branch can apply implicit score uplifts based on local/club ties | No branch exists to apply selective advantages; evaluation criteria are applied identically |
| **Loop Handling** | Preserves `DataCompletenessCheck` ↔ `RequestMoreInfo` loop | Preserves identical loop structure |
| **Final Review** | `ManagerialReview` receives candidates from either XOR path | `ManagerialReview` receives candidates from a single, unbiased path |

Both models strictly adhere to the POWL specification: `LOOPS` handle iterative data collection, `XOR` (Model 1 only) creates exclusive evaluative paths, and `StrictPartialOrder` enforces the required sequential dependencies across the hiring pipeline.
